note: The oldest app version that can read a language, or one file (ADR-0052, wiki). The index carries each as min_app; an app that knows it does not download what needs a newer app and says Needs app X, Update; older apps ignore it. Keys: languages {code: version}, files {decks/path.yaml: version}. Never set it for a language the latest release already ships, nor for a file it already reads: tools/deck_index.py refuses both (read from the latest v* tag; a warning without tags, an error in CI).
